name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: UI SDK ColorPicker styled: an area (painted on a canvas in OKLCH, every pixel a colour inside the gamut), hue and alpha sliders, a swatch, a text field for any CSS colour, channel inputs, presets and an eye dropper with a tooltip.
docs: `<ColorPicker defaultValue space format gamut>` in a `Field`, or with `aria-label`. With no children it renders an area (with `ColorPickerAreaCanvas` when `space="oklch"`), a hue slider, a swatch and a text field named by `labels.value` ("Colour value"). Compose `ColorPickerArea`, `ColorPickerAreaThumb`, `ColorPickerSlider channel orientation`, `ColorPickerSliderThumb`, `ColorPickerSwatch`, `ColorPickerInput`, `ColorPickerChannelInput channel`, `ColorPickerSwatches` of `ColorPickerSwatchItem value` (presets, 44px on touch) and `ColorPickerEyeDropper` (hidden where the browser can't pick from the screen). `onValueChange` runs on every step of a drag, `onValueCommit` once it ends, for saving. In OKLCH a thumb dragged or stepped past the gamut's edge stays where it was left, and the value is the closest colour inside the gamut.
